name: Automatic key discovery
description: Call translate(key, defaultText) in your app. LocaleKit ingests new keys as your team ships features — no spreadsheet handoffs.

name: Team review dashboard
description: Filter by locale, status, and environment. Edit inline, track review state, and publish when translations are ready.

name: @localekit/sdk
description: Lightweight client for web and Next.js. Load bundles at runtime, switch locales, and keep flags in sync with the same project.

name: Environments & versions
description: Stage copy in development, publish to production, and snapshot releases so rollbacks stay predictable.

name: AI fill & human review
description: Draft missing translations with AI, then approve or edit in the dashboard before anything goes live.

name: Flexible billing
description: Bill on a team retainer or per project — Starter for most teams, Enterprise when you need more languages and scale.
